Name: Pelipper Expander Gladiator Arena
Author: SonSDT
Description:
[center]
[b][color=#E6B84A][size=6] ⚔ PELIPPER EXPANDER GLADIATOR ARENA [/size][/color][/b]
[size=4][i]Train your Pokémon. Build your team. Fight for glory.[/i][/size]

[color=#AAAAAA]A new competitive battlefield for your Pokémon.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#aaaaaa][b][i]Try another mod in this series [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55373]Pelipper Expander PokeManager[/url][/i][/b]
[/color][/center]

[center][color=#D69B36]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D69B36][youtube]HOjrP7z8iEg[/youtube][/color][/center]

[size=5][b][color=#E6B84A]⚔ THE ARENA[/color][/b][/size]

Build an Arena on your farm and turn your Pokémon into a competitive battle team.

[list]
[*][color=#69B8E8][b]Arena Building[/b][/color] – Registration desk, records board and reward storage.[/*]
[*][color=#69B8E8][b]Team Deployment[/b][/color] – Position your Pokémon on the battlefield grid.[/*]
[*][color=#69B8E8][b]Tactical Combat[/b][/color] – Skills, mana, obstacles, status effects and Mega Skills.[/*]
[*][color=#69B8E8][b]Battle Reports[/b][/color] – Track damage, healing and knock-outs for every Pokémon.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b][color=#E6B84A]🏆 BATTLE MODES[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]1v1 / 2v2 / 4v4 / 6v6[/b] – Different team sizes and entry fees.[/*]
[*][b]Legendary Summon[/b] – Challenge powerful Legendary Pokémon and attempt to capture them.[/*]
[*][b]Contest[/b] – Test your team in special competitive activities.[/*]
[*][b]Defense[/b] – Survive increasingly difficult waves.[/*]
[*][b]Expedition[/b] – Fight through multiple floors.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b][color=#E6B84A]⚙ EQUIPMENT & PROGRESSION[/color][/b][/size]

Build stronger Pokémon with customizable equipment and upgrades.

[list]
[*]Weapons, armor and accessories with randomized main stats and substats.[/*]
[*]Multiple equipment quality tiers.[/*]
[*]Gems and star upgrades.[/*]
[*]Fashion items with cosmetic effects and stat bonuses.[/*]
[*]Movement speed bonuses also affect mountable Pokémon.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b][color=#E6B84A]🔥 RANKING & COMPETITION[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Rank-based opponent scaling.[/*]
[*]Enemy Pokémon equipped with their own gear and skills.[/*]
[*]Win streaks, ranking points and Arena Tokens.[/*]
[*]Entry fees, stakes and streak penalties on defeat.[/*]
[*]Streak Protection Cards and match buffs.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b][color=#E6B84A]💰 ARENA ECONOMY[/color][/b][/size]

Give your accumulated gold and surplus resources a new purpose.

[list]
[*]Equipment Shop, Forge and Workshop.[/*]
[*]Gacha Wheel and additional rewards.[/*]
[*]Convert surplus materials into useful resources.[/*]
[*]Sell unwanted equipment for Arena Tokens.[/*]
[/list][center][color=#D69B36]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]

[size=5][b][color=#E6B84A]📦 INSTALLATION[/color][/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install the Pelipper Pokémon mod and its dependencies.[/*]
[*]Extract this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game and visit Robin.[/*]
[*]Build the Arena house on your farm.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b][color=#E6B84A]📋 REQUIREMENTS[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later.[/*]
[*]SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Pelipper Pokémon mod.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b][color=#E6B84A]🌐 LANGUAGES[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#69B8E8]English[/color]  •  [color=#69B8E8]Tiếng Việt[/color]

[center][color=#D69B36]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]

[size=5][b][color=#E6B84A]🔮 PLANNED FEATURES[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Seasonal tournaments and exclusive rewards.[/*]
[*]Daily and weekly challenges.[/*]
[*]Team Presets.[/*]
[*]Spectator Betting.[/*]
[*]Battle Replay and Highlights.[/*]
[*]More Rival Trainers and signature teams.[/*]
[*]Casual, Normal and Hardcore difficulty presets.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b][color=#E6B84A]🐛 FEEDBACK & BUG REPORTS[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Report bugs in the Bugs tab with your SMAPI log.[/*]
[*]Balance suggestions are always welcome.[/*]
[*]Combat, equipment, prices and rewards are continuously open to tuning.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b][color=#E6B84A]❤️ SPECIAL THANKS[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]AlexanderVerde[/b] – Author of Pelipper Town, for creating the Pokémon system this project builds upon.[/*]
[*][b]Pelipper Town Team[/b] – For bringing Pokémon into Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*][b]Pathoschild and the SMAPI team[/b] – For SMAPI and the modding framework.[/*]
[*]Everyone who tested the mod and reported bugs. Thank you![/*]
[/list][center][color=#D69B36]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#E6B84A]☕ SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT[/color][/b][/size]

If you enjoy this mod, you can buy me a coffee ^^

[url=https://sonhongnguyen.info.vn/donate][b][color=#E6B84A]☕ GIVE ME A CUP OF COFFEE[/color][/b][/url]

[color=#AAAAAA]Every bit of support helps me improve the Arena and develop new features.[/color]

[i]Thank you for playing![/i]
[/center]
